one_liner: Composed young lady of a distinguished house who vows to win every race because fate demands it.
personality: Her profile calls her a lady of a distinguished family who runs as fate commands, and her self-introduction promises to win any race 'if that is the destiny I must follow'. Her few lines are short, formal and polite, with a sense of solemn vows and contracts. Little else is in the data; she is not playable, and appears only through support cards.
